items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I mean we were doing Strayhorn

ctx.x: Marian’s tunes, her choice of tunes, like Dave’s was exquisite. I mean we were doing Strayhorn and she’d sketch a lot of stuff out for me later on. She had a real fast hand and she’d write out changes. And she was a very fine writer. She’s written all kinds of great tunes, one of which I’ve recorded, “Twilight World.” It was a title tune for a limited issue CD I did. Talk about a vanity project, every dime of it was mine. And I think I sold about five of them and I gave away about four hundred.
